answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded stake whose weight ramps along a comet-like curve toward a protocol zenith, so fresh identities stay negligible until seasoned. Validators cross-attest stake provenance through a shared timber of hash-linked registration records, making fabricated histories detectable and costly to graft. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
